A PREMIUM STAY AT PULLMAN SYDNEY HYDE PARK
DISCOVER REFINED FACILITIES & EXCLUSIVE SERVICE IN OUR LUXURY HOTEL IN SYDNEY
The premium Pullman Sydney Hyde Park welcomes business and leisure travellers with contemporary accommodation , unique amenities, and an absolutely perfect location in the epicentre of the arts, retail, and business precincts. Situated opposite iconic Hyde Park, our hotel features 241 inviting guest rooms and suites, equipped with every possible convenience and boasting striking Sydney views.
Pullman Sydney Hyde Park is also home to a spectacular rooftop pool and recreation deck, excellent on-site dining, and ten meeting spaces offering natural light and the latest meeting technology.
If you're looking to explore during your visit, you'll find our hotel ideally placed near some of Sydney's most popular attractions, we well as the vibrant Surry Hills dining scene and fantastic nightlife on Oxford Street. And with our close proximity to public transport, you can easily explore beyond the CBD.
The visit of a lifetime awaits you here at our premium hotel in Sydney. Book your stay at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park today.
HOTEL FEATURES
Outdoor rooftop pool overlooking the Sydney CBD, Hyde Park and East Sydney
On-site fitness centre
Sauna

Ten meeting spaces, with most featuring natural light and pillar-less spaces

Premium Hotel Rooms in Sydney
Make yourself at home here in the Darlinghurst area. The contemporary hotel accommodation at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park is immaculately designed with rich, sophisticated tones, and is among the largest in the CBD, ranging in size from 32 square metres to 54 square metres. All of our hotel rooms feature exquisite views of East Sydney, Hyde Park, or the CBD. Hotel room amenities include flat-screen TVs, signature Pullman mattresses, mini-fridges, and high-speed Internet access for absolute comfort and total relaxation. A spacious work desk ensures you can stay connected; marble bathrooms with stylish fittings add an extra touch of refinement to your Darlinghurst stay.

What are the check-in and check-out times for Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
Check-in at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park is from 2 pm, and check-out time is 11 am. Please contact the hotel directly for options available for early check-in or late check-out.
Can you store my bags before I check in and after I check out?
Yes our front desk will hold them for you until you're ready.
What are the food & beverage options in Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
Pullman Sydney Hyde Park restaurant, Windows On The Park is open for breakfast and dinner. Click here for information on the opening and closing times of the restaurant.
BarThirty6 is open for lunch, dinner, afternoon and evening drinks. Click here for information on the opening and closing times of the bar.
Room Service is also available for 24 hours daily.
What are the prices for breakfast at Windows On The Park?
40 AUD per person and children under 12 eat free with every paying adult.
What are the fitness facilities available at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
Pullman Sydney Hyde Park have a 24 hour gymnasium.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park have an executive lounge?
No, Pullman Sydney Hyde Park does not have an executive lounge.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park have a pool or jacuzzi/spa?
Yes, Pullman Sydney Hyde Park has the best rooftop pool in town and it's heated too! You'll love it!
Our spa bath may not be bubbling right now, but it's still a perfect place to soak your stress away. A brand-new bubbly experience is coming soon.
We appreciate your patience while we work on bringing the bubbles back, better than ever.
Open 6am - 11pm everyday.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park offer laundry service?
Yes, Pullman Sydney Hyde Park does have laundry service. Please check with reception on prices. Please note laundry service is unavailable on Sundays and public holidays.
What are the special offers available at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
Click here for the latest offers at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park where you can find information on our activations like Candy hour and many more.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park offer parking?
Yes, Pullman Sydney Hyde Park offers convenient on-site hotel parking in Sydney's city centre, ideal for day visitors and overnight guests.
Casual Parking Rates
0 - 1 hour: 30
1 - 2 hours: 45
2 - 3 hours: 55
3+ hours: 75
Hotel Guest Parking
Overnight parking for in-house guests is 62 per night.
In-house guests can pre-book parking via Drivo here . We highly recommend pre-booking via Drivo to ensure your car spot is reserved, as spaces are limited.
Vehicles departing after 12:00pm on check-out day will be charged 30 per hour, capped at 75 per day.
Parking is subject to availability and prices are subject to change.
Is there complimentary airport shuttle available at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
No, there is no airport shuttle available at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park.
Can I bring my pet to Pullman Sydney Hyde Park?
No, pets are not allowed at Pullman Sydney Hyde Park.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park have a NABERS Ratings?
Yes, we have a current NABERS rating of 3 for Water and 3.5 for Energy. Click here to find out more about NABERS.
Does Pullman Sydney Hyde Park accept cash?
No, Pullman Sydney Hyde Park is a cashless hotel.
Are there any maintenance works happening at the hotel?
Yes, please note our lifts are currently undergoing upgrades to serve you better. During this modernisation, a limited number of lifts will be in operation, and you may notice longer wait times, particularly during peak check-in and check-out hours. We kindly ask that you allow more time for travel to and from your room during busy periods, and consider an earlier check-out to avoid the rush. We apologise for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
Please note the spa is also under modernisation. Stay tuned!
